venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.weather: 75, overcast; felt like rain all day but didn't
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Monday 10/5 (MOD MKZ).** Net sales $654 vs target $848 (-22.9%). Food $122. Comps $4.40 (community member/investor 10%). 17 guests, check avg $38.46. Quiet Monday; neighborhood regulars Ben and Zach hung out while the team decorated for Halloween. Meal Deals running all day seem to have lifted food a bit (6 sold). Bubbles and Adventure Gimlets top sellers. Kitchen: orders out on time, BOH ABK list done. 86: Jameson, Crown, High Life; low tonic. Maintenance: missing a toast handheld. No incidents.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Monday 10/5 (MOD & Chef KK DJ).** Net sales $606 vs target $1,238 (-51.0%). Food $56. Comps $23 / 3.8% (low sales inflated %; a few bingo credits). 25 guests, check avg $23. Slow night; handful of business folks at 4:30 and late a group of young women who'd released a film at the Nashville film festival (won several awards). Late-night movie: Nope. Kitchen smooth, decent Meal Deal sales. Low IPA. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Monday 10/5 (AM Maggies; PM Carey).** Net sales $7,916.19 vs target $7,477 (+5.9%). AM $773.67 / PM $7,142.52. Food $2,236.80. Comps $287.35 / 3.63%. 194 guests (Tock). Calm all day with a minor pop around 9a; around 8pm a strong dinner rush with the kitchen rocking — team made the revenue goal. Kitchen just two on the line, a little busy after 8PM. Oat milk received; fresh iced black tea. Team on point; solid Monday. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Monday 10/5 (MOD & Chef Kyler, Will).** Net sales $5,711 vs target $3,739 (+52.7%). Food $454, beverage $5,257. Comps $95.04 (mostly members). 144 guests, check avg $40. Chill first turn then largely full until midnight, ~1-hour waitlist; pre-busy season continuing. 4 large parties, 7 solos, 2 investor cocktails; fit a $400 12-top around 11. Top sellers: 66 oysters, Rosalie, Burner Phone, Native Lion. Tenzin never behind. Door: great weather, AD Week/industry/finance crowd, walk-in parties of 8 and 12 around 8pm; 1 no-show (1 cover). Menu count 18. No charges.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Monday 10/5 (MOD & Chef Mikey, Saleh & Angel).** Net sales $4,429 vs target $3,770 (+17.5%). Marquee $4,429 (food $1,044); Standing Room closed. Comps $160 (industry friends, investor party, service recovery for unseasoned fries/oyster ticket times +20m, bday, employee food discounts). 116 guests, check avg $38.18 (reported avg order $82.03). Steady start, room filled, waitlist ~10pm; one larger party couldn't be seated. Kitchen made mignonette on the fly, pushing oyster times. Familiar faces incl. industry friends and Hendricks reps. No health inspector return. Busy for a Monday. Pepita orgeat nearly 86; low black pepper; eyes on Loud Silence, Living Dead, Lucky Star, Shinebox. No-shows charged.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Monday 10/5 (MOD Josh).** Net sales $2,329.69 vs target $2,397 (-2.8%). Marquee bar $2,351.49, food $378. Comps $21.80, voids $41. 62 guests, GCA $38.19 (check avg $95.16). Slow first couple hours, picked up ~8pm with a few 5-tops and several 2-tops, near target; dropped off ~10:15 and soft breakdown by 10:30. One bartender, team pitched in. Kitchen slow; top sellers tuna crudo, oysters, cheese plate. Garden closed. To improve: clear KDS. Maintenance: curtains, service tin rinser (parts ordered). No incidents.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Rainstorms through the day, warm and muggy
venues.narrative: **MG — Monday 10/5 (AM Franck & Marcus/Shannon; PM Justin & Marcus/Shannon).** Net sales $6,680 vs target $4,415 (+51.3%). Municipal Bar AM $879 / PM $5,801; Sun Club and Hot Eye $0. Food $3,178. Comps $44.50. 169 guests (OpenTable 24 AM + 145 PM), check avg $39.53. Slow morning (four food tours ~half of AM sales); walk-ins at 5:30 filled the room near capacity to close, pops at 6 and 8, and a group of 30 at 9:45 for drinks. Sun Club closed for weather. Kitchen steady; Marcus covered for a sick cook. No 86s. Maintenance: bar Cryssali. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Monday 10/5 (MOD Curtis Hayes).** Net sales $7,023 vs target $9,166 (-23.4%). Food $881. Comps $450.10 / 6.4% (lots of industry; full comp tab for Ardelle and partner; DNLs $105). 168 guests (73 reservations), avg guest spend $41.56. Lighter sales day in line with last week's Monday trend; industry-heavy; light walk-ins early despite sun (Seahawks win likely tamed the crowd), walk-ins picked up 7-7:30 in manageable waves. Smooth shift, no equipment issues, no 86s or incidents. New kitchen schedule noted. Birthday in party pod.
